meta_rows: Hospitalization: Did this happen at age 50+ years old? - Insight46 phase 2

This longer head injury self-complete questionnaire was introduced to Insight 46 during phase 2. Limited head injury questions were asked during the phase 1 clinical interview (see file handle I46_familyHistory), and were  repeated during the phase 2 clinical interview (see file handle I462_history).
cat_rows: This category contains information on history of head injury of the participants in the Insight46 sub-study.
